reviews.comment: Everybody who takes ACCT 229 knows how good she is and they are not wrong. She explains everything so clearly that I don't even think I could've done as good as I did if I had any other professor. I'm shocked by how good she explained everything and how easy she made it to understand the new complex content we were learning.

She explained the concepts well and made everything easy to understand. Make sure to go to every lecture and stay on top of everything, or you will probably fall behind. The accounting help desk is also a great resource for help on quizzes and exam prep

Best prof for 229. Class is hard but not super bad if you study. Only issue is there will ALWAYS be questions on the test that don't correlate to what you see on the practice test...always. Should be fine if you know the concepts but it does get a little ridiculous when you do a practice test 5 times and half the test unrecognizable. TAKE KNOOP
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Knoop is very respected in Mays and in her community. A great person and professor. She wants to see you improve through the semester. Use the help desk provided, they are a great resource.
She was a great professor. exams are really important. Last exam was really hard so do good on the first two.
The most amazing professor. Literally the only reason I passed was because of her. Don't take anyone else for this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Dr. Knoop is well loved for a reason. She lays the class out from the beginning and goes over everything in detail. Attend every lecture, ask every question, and study study study. Usually her classes are hard to get into, but if you can definitely put your focus on her lectures. 
Also, do every work page available to you. All practice helps.

I'm gonna be honest my view of Knoop was very closely tied to my view of 229 itself, which I hated, but Knoop is a very good professor for it! She's so sweet and genuinely wants to help you, but I really disliked the course because she does make the tests really really hard and challenges you a lot, but keep in mind i was in the honors sector.

Engaging lectures. Difficult class but doable as long as you show up and continually review your notes and work practice problems and practice exams multiple times before the exams. Old Army Tutoring helped a lot on the more difficult topics.

The best professor I have ever had. I did not think I would major in accounting coming into this class, but she has changed my perspective completely. The class is hard but definitely doable with her. Fight for the seat in the class during registration!!! She made the class so interesting and enjoyable.

Not sure I can say anything that other reviews haven't covered already. Knoop cares about her subject and her students, driving them to succeed. The class itself can be difficult, but if you stay on top of everything and don't get behind, you'll be fine. I would 100% recommend taking her if you have the option.

ACCT 229 is a challenging course, but taking Knoop helped so much. The class requires a lot of reviewing outside of class, but Knoop's lectures were engaging, and she made the material easy to understand. She also cares for her students and is easily approachable if you have any questions. Knoop helped me confirm my decision to major in accounting!

Professor Knoop was an amazing professor!! Her lectures were well organized and thoughtful as they were taught in a way that allowed students to understand the material clearly. I would recommend Knoop to any business student. She helped me find my love for accounting. Lots of partial credit saved my life for sure!!

The most amazing ACCT 229 professor at Mays. If you have the opportunity to take her, be grateful as you will learn a lot and your eyes will be opened. Show up to class, study bare minimum one week in advance by redoing the quiz problems and practice exams. Do it to the point where you can close your eyes and you can recall the steps and numbers.

Knoop is an amazing prof and explains acct in a way students can understand. However, 229 is a REALLY HARD class. GO TO EVERY CLASS because each lecture covers a lot of material. Do the recommended HW, additional problems, quizzes, SI sessions, practice exams to do good on the exams. Slight curve offered at the very end. Help desk is a life saver.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Go to class! Knoop makes accounting much more understandable. Skip? You're cooked. 229 is hard, but not impossible, in fact, it's a lot easier than high school AP classes. I recommend going to help desk and get your questions answered fast bc it will snowball. Keep recalling your notes from previous chapters, you will thank me during finals study.
She rocks. The class is going to be hard no matter who you take it with. She ensures students understand what is going on, and goes out of her way to make connections with them.

Professor Knoop was amazing!!! She is my favorite professor, you can tell she really cares about her students and how they do in her class.  Her class is difficult but if you attend lectures, go to the help desk, and attend office hours you should be ok.  Knoop cares so much and is one of the best professors I've ever had.

If you have the opportunity to take ACCT229 from Knoop, PLEASE DO!!! She is an amazing prof both inside and outside the classroom and sets her students up for success. Take advantage of the resources provided. She takes the course very seriously and expects that her students do as well. She loves her students well!!!

really tough class, but please please do not take Honors 229. It is a nightmare. However, Knoop is the best professor within 229! Lots of extra information sprinkled into the Honors exams which complicates the overall material.

If you're taking 229 try to get Knoop she's so understanding and only wants you to succeed. Best way to succeed for exams is to go back over the notes/examples, rework quizzes, & complete the additional problems. The practice test is the best gauge of how prepared you are for the exam. Don't take it until you feel like you could take the real exam.

Definitely one of the best, if not the best professor/teacher I've had in my career as a student. She really cares about each person individually, and understands that accounting isn't for everyone. A lot of people say it's super hard to get an A but honestly as long as you spend a little time after class looking over material you'll be fine.

I never write reviews on my professors but had to write one for Knoop! She is such an amazing teacher and made learning ACCT 229 much simpler and was always so accessible if students needed help. This is for sure one of the hardest classes I have ever taken but as long as you study at least a week before the tests, an A is attainable.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Knoop is the best professor I have ever had. She cares about each of her students and genuinely wants to get to know each of them. She teaches in a way that helps us understand very difficult concepts, and is available outside of class. The course itself is very difficult, but if you can get Professor Knoop, do!!!! Her class fills up fast

WOW SHE IS AMAZING!!! Knoop is definitely the best professor I've ever had. She is kind, flexible, truly cares about her students, and overall a really great person. ACCT 299 is a hard class in general, but Knoop makes it very clear and manageable. Attendance is not mandatory, but go to class if you want to suceed. An A or B is totally achievable!!

Amazing professor. She will tell you on the first day that the class is hard, and it is, but she is by far the most caring and understanding professor you will have. She teaches the class material very well and is great at what she does. Attendance is not graded, but you will fall behind if you do not go to class. Top tier person and instructor.

Guys,

Knoop does a good job. BUT GO TO MAYSTUTORS. Game Changer! They teach you how to be successful in this class. Definitely worth it! Do it yall!

This is a challenging class, but Professor Knoop works to make it manageable for students. She's very caring and available outside of class to work with students. To succeed, you HAVE to study the lectures outside of class and do additional practice problems. If you don't, it's really easy to forget content between lectures and fall behind.

Great prof! Knoop cares deeply about her students, and it is very evident that she knows what she is talking about and wants each of her students to succeed. This class is TOUGH no matter who you have. The course is graded 80% on exams. It is easy to succeed with an A/B if you put in the effort early! Do NOT wait until the last minute to study.

Professor Knoop was such a great professor. People tend to rate a professor more poorly when the class material is more difficult, but Knoop is so helpful and patient to us students. Go to her office hours, pay attention in class, NO PHONES, and ask questions. She is super nice, and understanding and wants best for you. Take her for this course.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Great class, great professor! The material learned is not so hard itself, it is just a lot to learn/remember. I attended SI's, reviewed my notes before/ after class, and went to the help desk. Put in the work, study a week before the exam and make sure you understand everything that is going on and you'll do good!

Knoop is an amazing professor and an equally amazing person. The reason I rated the class tough (and I assume the same for everyone else) is strictly because the class is difficult, not her grading. She is easily the best 229 professor at A&M.

Prof Knoop is really clear in lectures, she tells you exactly what you need to know for exams. The content of the course itself is hard, but she makes it easier to understand and breaks it down pretty well. Help desk also was amazing. Hwk is just the right amount and really help you to understand the concepts taught in class.
Her teaching style is average but she has a very rotten personality and does not care about everyone (just specific people if you get what I mean)

3 ways to make an A: 1) GO TO CLASS; class is challenging and Knoop does a great job at teaching material 2) RE WORK QUIZZES & PRACTICE EXAMS; this helped me when studying 3) GO TO HELP DESK & SI SESSIONS; you have to put in the work to make an A and TAs are very helpful. Getting repetition/practice and not getting behind is KEY to making an A

Best professor for ACC 229. If I had one piece of advice it would be to memorize your notes and master all problems she gives you. There are quizzes for each chapter, a group project, and three tests.

This class was tough, but professor Knoop made it straightforward. Because there's so much material in the class, don't let it pile up. If you don't understand something, immediately read the textbook or go to the SI sessions. Also, practice is crucial. Redo the notes problems, additional problems, and quizzes until you've mastered it all.

Professor Knoop is undoubtedly the nicest professor I have had in my first year at TAMU. This class is not too difficult if you attend lecture, take good notes, and go to the help desk or office hours for extra questions. There is also typically a curve at the end of the semester that should help your grade. 10/10 recommend.

hard class, everything pretty much comes down to if you test good. great person but when it came to teaching what needed to be on exams, it was not really there. not really ever any extra credit, lecture was okay but did not completely help with exams. questions on exams were different than quizzes and or practice problems. take her if need to pass

Can't say enough good things about Professor Knoop. She literally made us cookies before tests and many refer to her as Momma K. This class is very hard, but that's definitely a me problem. Would 10/10 take a bullet for this woman.

Momma K hands down the best for 229 and maybe all of Mays. Class requires attentiveness during lectures and serious study outside of class, but study material is just like tests. She is accessible, so friendly, and cares about her students personally. Would build my entire schedule around her section if I were you.

Best professor I've had. ACCT 229 is one of the hardest classes I've ever taken, would not have done as well if I didn't have Knoop. Sweet, funny, caring, and takes her class and students very seriously. It's a hard class, but she makes it work!
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Funniest sweetest prof ever. Cares about her students and wants them to succeed. Available for office hours and encourages on your own ACCT practice. Gave us treats and was so kind
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Knoop is the BESTTTTT professor i have had at TAMU. The material is not as hard as you think. At first I struggled and even got a C on an exam. The best advice I can give is to review your notes and make sure you understand everything before entering the next class. ( that is what got me the A)

The course consists of 3 exams, a group project, 10 quizzes (3 are dropped), and a final exam. Knoop is the one who writes parts of the exams so she makes sure youre prepared for it. The way I succeeded in this class was redoing the notes and the additional problems she provided until I understood everything. I highly recommend taking her!

Knoop is an amazing professor. I am not great at accounting, but I couldn't have asked for a better prof. Definitely do all quizzes, attend all classes, study up hard. This class is tough, and the exams will kick your butt if you let them. Don't underestimate this class, and take Knoop if you can!
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Knoop is the best professor I have ever had. ACCT 229 does live up to its reputation in difficulty, but with a lot of work and proper preparation for the exams, you will pass. She is happy to answer any questions you may have and is the reason I found a love for accounting and will be majoring in it. If you can, take momma K!!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Knoop is the best accounting professor at A&M. 229 is a hard class overall but she really does make it enjoyable. You can tell that she really cares about her students and wants them to suceeed. Highly recommend taking her for 229
Knoop is the best accounting prof! Really wants everyone to succeed in her class. You have to put in the effort to get the grade you want, but she is always available to answer your questions.

An amazing professor! She is so sweet and funny! Truly cares about her students and really wants you to understand it! ACCT 229 is such a hard class but she teaches it so well to where it's fairly easy to understand! Take her at all costs!!! You definitely HAVE to go to every lecture to understand it, but that goes for every teacher in ACCT 229.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: ACCT 229 is one of the hardest classes I've taken here, but Knoop makes it enjoyable. You definitely have to put in a lot of effort to earn your grade, but she makes it a great experience. She genuinely cares about her students and teaches the material extremely well.

Prof. Knoop is the kindest professor I have had at TAMU. ACCT 229 is really hard, and you really have to work for the grade you want. BUT Knoop makes it fair. She wants her students to understand and exceed. She will work with you and her lectures are extremely clear and thorough. The tests are HARD but she writes them and knows how to help!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Easily the prof I've had so far at Texas A&M. Accounting is not easy, but Knoop makes the experience the best it can possibly be. There's no way of getting around the difficulty of the tests, but work hard & you can get the grades you want. Plenty of outside resources available. She goes by Momma K, but I just prefer to call her the GOAT. Take her

ACCT 229 is tough no matter who you take, but take Knoop if you can. She is so sweet, and care a lot about her students. She explains the material the best out of all the professors. She doesn't sugar coat how hard her tests are, so get ready to go to tutoring and STUDY if you aren't a natural accountant.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Knoop is absolutely amazing!! This was one of my harder classes, but I felt like I learned SO SO much about accounting this year. Prof. Knoop will push you to your full potential, potential that you didn't know you had. There's also so many resources (HelpDesk, TAs, office hours)!
Professor Knoop cares about her students and explains the content of the class in a way students can understand.

Prof Knoop is the sweetest professor you will ever have! She cares deeply about her students and wants each of them to succeed! Her exams are tough, but she is very willing to meet up with you outside of class, which I definitely recommend. Her TAs are great too, so help is always available to you.

By far the best professor I have had at A&M. She truly cares about her students learning, and basically is just everybodys mom. Absolutely wonderful professor that will make accounting seem interesting even to those who hate it
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures--Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Knoop truly cares if you are learning. Go talk to her, and she will lead to all the resources you need to succeed (her office hours, and TA Help Desk-which she is in charge of). You do need to study hard for tests, and not fall behind. No reason not to make 100's on all quizzes and group project (TA's will check your answers). Overall, real gem.

Professor Knoop is the best professor I have ever had. She seriously cares about her students and makes sure they know all the resources available to them to succeed in the class. BY FAR the best 229 prof, everyone wishes they took her. She does the exam review sessions for all 229 kids, so you know she's the best. Super funny and caring.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: Mrs. Knoop was so kind and you could really tell she knew her accounting stuff. However, I felt that sometimes she was almost TOO smart for us and would go too fast or skip over "simple things," leaving me confused. She's extremely caring though and is willing to help you outside of class- which you'll probably need. Super respected and talented.

Without a doubt the best professor I have ever had, and probably will ever have. Mrs. Knoop is so kind, caring, and helpful. She is always willing to go the extra mile for her students and genuinely cares about us not just as students, but as people. If I could take this class over and over, I would without hestitation. She's the reason I love ACCT

Knoop is one of the best professors I've had so far. She truly cares about her students and is willing to help them succeed. The class is difficult and requires critical thinking, but there are resources to help you succeed, and Knoop does a good job of explaining concepts and using examples that are clear and concise. Attendance is a good idea.

Knoop is the best professor and person that I have ever met. I love her with my entire heart. Her class was challenging simply because of the material but she's great about answering questions in class and she loves to help her students!!! Definitely TAKE HER for 229.

Professor Knoop is the best prof I've ever had--and I tend to like most of my profs. The class was hard, but I learned so much. She is brilliant, explains things clearly, and really loves each of her students. Once, when I needed help but she couldn't meet, she gave me her cell #. Class is very fast paced--don't skip class and don't get behind.

Knoop cares about each of her students' success, but I just flat out did not understand accounting no matter how hard I tried. Knoop is the best prof at teaching accounting, but the lectures go too fast for me. If I could take again, I would take someone who doesn't give pop quizzes so I could replace class time with tutoring.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: One of the best professors that I have had at A&M, if not the best. The material for this class is NOT easy, but if you attend class and pay attention to how she works the problems you should be fine. Practice goes a long way with this class. She provides plenty of additional problems online for us to work, as well as the answers. Amazing Prof!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This class was super difficult. There was at times a disconnect between the teacher and her students because she would give us an "easy" test where the class average was almost failing. Some people really get accounting but if you don't then grades do not come easy. Help desk was helpful but prof was super busy and it made the class harder.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Best professor I have had at A&M. She cares about her students, and even years later will do anything to help you out.

I took Knoop for ACCT229 and she really takes time to make sure everyone gets the material. Her lectures clear up a lot of things and her outlines really eliminate heavy reliance on your textbook. She cares a lot about her students and her tests are fair. Class is challenging but definitely do-able if you put some effort. Highly recommend her.

TAKE MRS. KNOOP IF AT ALL POSSIBLE FOR 229!!!  She truly cares about her students and there is no reason to feel nervous if you go talk to her.  Go to class, do the hw and quizzes, and ask for help when you need it.  You will receive whatever grade you earn based on the amount of time an effort you put in.  I'm a marketing & terrible at math, too.

AMAZING PROF! She genuinely cares for her students and says she is our mom. She explains things really well and puts things in terms we understand. She is more than willing to help if you ask for it. Not gonna lie the class is hard and you have to work for it but with her its totally manageable. Definitely take her!!

The absolute best professor ive ever had. Shes thoughtful, clear and genuinely enjoys her job and cares about the students. She was super supportive with both class and personal endeavors and offered nothing but help whenever asked. She doesnt like texting in class which really isnt much to ask. Dont miss class or youll fall behind. TAKE HER!

Even though they say Acct 229 is hard, Ms. Knoop just constantly finds ways to make it easier. There are 3 tests and a final (100 each) that most students will earn between a 83-93. There is a built in 100 points curve if you do the homework (9 problems - that the TA give the answers) that she gives every two weeks. Def Take her
She was great! Very nice and helpful.
AWESOME prof!! She will teach you everything you need to know, just make sure to go to class.
take her for accounting if you can, the best there is.
